resources.string: Keeps the songs on this phone. Run it here, and the phone you use can find it and save to it.
Type this code on the other phone

1. Start the bridge here.
2. On the phone you use, open AutoSongs and press Pair remote bridge.
3. Type the code above. The phone finds this bridge by itself and sets up the address.

Then, in that app's Settings, choose Download to the bridge.
Android closes apps that sit in the background. Give this one an exemption and the bridge stays up.
This app is already allowed to run in the background
Could not open the settings page
Songs are put in %1$s and then moved into this phone\'s Music folder, under AutoSongs.
Allow notifications, so the bridge can show its code and keep running in the background.
